objective: Implement Roadmap A C01+C02 as local product creative logic on the existing A02 contracts
source_observation: Detached checkout HEAD read from its worktree metadata; no GitHub/main freshness claim
acceptance: Lossless Vietnamese/Unicode freeform intake and existing JSON ContentBrief validation using the unchanged A02 schema
No required SKU, product, CTA, storyboard, KPI or concept count
Explicit provider-neutral reasoner injection with a TEST_ONLY_MOCK deterministic fixture and no default fallback
One concept by default; optional distinct idea families; mock capacity is not a product quota
Validated immutable concept identity, brief digest, revision, source references and observed-or-UNKNOWN model metadata
Separate optional reframe operation with parent revision/digest, lens and exact text changes
Immutable brief snapshots, concept revisions and selections; conflicting versions refuse overwrite
A05 consumer input reconstructs from stored selection without chat history
No concept record may promote factual_status to VERIFIED or rights_status to GRANTED

implementation.intake: Lossless mapping to A02 objective/prompt; no semantic extraction claim; additional JSON fields preserved
implementation.mock: Four deterministic test families: sensory poem, object-perspective comedy, reverse-time mystery, impossible field guide
implementation.reframe: Explicit local lens plus caller-supplied creative text changes; no model response is invented
implementation.brief_versions: Content-addressed full canonical A02 JSON snapshots
implementation.concept_versions: Stable initial concept_id; sequential immutable revisions linked to parent digest
implementation.selection: Content-addressed record pinned to exact concept revision/digest; does not authorize rendering or publication
implementation.consumer_api: CreativeStore.load_selected(selection_id) returns detached brief, concept and selection JSON

verification.invocation: Python runpy executed pytest.__main__ with the listed module arguments, after applying the recorded environment; no test skipping or changed verification profile

project_tests.powershell_error: WinError 1920: The file cannot be accessed by the system

package_build.attempt: setuptools.build_meta.build_wheel in a disposable source copy

verification.scope: All 136 preexisting index entries compared read-only: no tracked modifications or deletions; new authored files restricted to allowed paths

risk_notes: Implementation status is scoped local code, not full project verification, wheel installation, live model capability, creative quality or external acceptance
Freeform intake preserves text; the mock uses templates and does not understand natural language like a real model
References and incoming assertions remain unverified; A03 does not verify external facts, licenses, rights or commercial outcomes
Store is local append-only storage, not a transactional database; a crash can leave a partial new file that is rejected rather than overwritten
Git/PowerShell environment failures and the missing setuptools dependency remain unresolved; no out-of-scope environment or engineering fixes were made
